staffpay.title: Staff salaries
staffpay.lead: Monthly salaries of reception, nursing, accounting and support staff. Doctors are paid through doctor payroll.
staffpay.fixed_deductions_help: Taken every month, e.g. social security share.
staffpay.net_formula: Net = base + allowances + bonuses − deductions − advances
staffpay.link_help: Link a team member who signs in to DocBook. Doctor logins are paid through doctor payroll.
staffpay.employee_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Unpaid months of this employee are removed too.
staffpay.employees_note: Changes to an employee's salary apply to unpaid months only. Paid months keep the figures they were paid with.
staffpay.empty_text: Add the people you pay a monthly salary to — reception, nurses, accountant, cleaners.
staffpay.missing_title: {n} active employees are not in this month's run yet
staffpay.missing_ask: Ask someone who manages payroll to prepare the month.
staffpay.prepared_none: Every active employee is already in this month.
staffpay.no_run_title: This month has not been prepared
staffpay.no_run_text: Prepare the month to create a salary line for each active employee.
staffpay.sheet_note: Amounts in {currency}. Paid salaries are locked and count in the profit & loss and budgets.
staffpay.draft_note: Not paid yet — figures may still change.
staffpay.adj_help: An advance paid during the month is taken back from this month's salary.
staffpay.pay_lock_help: Once paid, the month is locked for this employee.
staffpay.reopen_warning: Reopening removes the payment record so the month can be corrected. It is written to the audit log with your reason.

partners.title: Partner accounts
partners.lead: Partners' shares, capital injections and drawings, and each month's profit share.
partners.empty_text: Add the clinic's owners with their investment and share to follow capital and profit shares.
partners.equity_under: Active partners hold {pct} together — {rest} is not assigned. Profit can be distributed once the total is 100%.
partners.equity_over: Active partners hold {pct} together, more than 100%. Correct the shares.
partners.tx_empty_text: Capital injections, withdrawals and profit shares appear here.
partners.month_open: This month is still open. Profit can be distributed after it ends.
partners.need_100: Distribution needs the active partners' shares to total exactly 100%.
partners.estimate_note: Shares shown are an estimate until the month is distributed.
partners.distribute_confirm: Record each partner's share of {amount} for {month}? This is done once per month.
partners.distribute_help: Records each active partner's share of the month's net profit (a loss is shared the same way).
partners.cancel_confirm: Cancel the distribution of {month}? The partners' profit shares for that month are removed. Type the month to confirm.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.lead: Monthly spending limits per expense category and for salaries and supplies, with alerts before they run out.
budgets.empty_text: Set a monthly limit for rent, supplies, salaries or any expense category and get an alert when it is nearly used.
budgets.scope_help: Expense categories come from Expenses. Salaries and supplies use their own records.
budgets.threshold_help: Owners and accountants are notified once when this share is reached, and once when the limit is exceeded.
budgets.sources_note: Expenses by date; staff and doctor salaries by the month they were paid for; supplies by purchase orders fully received in the month.
budgets.history_hint: Usage of each budget in the last 6 months (current limit).

pnl.title: Income statement
pnl.lead: Income statement from the clinic's invoices, expenses and salaries.
pnl.basis_short: Cash basis: money collected and paid
pnl.basis_text: Cash basis. Revenue is what was collected: invoices issued at payment (cashier, front desk and online card payments), after discounts. A refunded online payment voids its invoice, so it is already out of revenue. Expenses count by their date; doctor and staff salaries count for the month they were paid for, including advances taken back. Supplies received on purchase orders are not added — their bills are recorded as expenses, so adding them would count them twice.
pnl.no_trend: No revenue or costs in the last 12 months yet.
pnl.budgets_ok: All budgets are within their limits this month.
pnl.partners_note: Share of the net profit of {period} by current shares (estimate).
pnl.overlap_title: Staff pay may be counted twice
pnl.overlap_text: This period has expenses in the "Staff salaries" category and paid staff salaries. If they are the same payments, delete the expense entries.

errors_finance.LINE_PAID: This salary is already paid and locked. Reopen it first.
errors_finance.NOT_PAID: This salary is not marked as paid.
errors_finance.EMPLOYEE_HAS_PAID: This employee has paid salaries on record. Mark them inactive instead.
errors_finance.MEMBER_LINKED: This login is already linked to another employee.
errors_finance.EQUITY_OVER_100: Active partners would hold {total}% together — the total cannot exceed 100%.
errors_finance.EQUITY_NOT_100: Active partners must hold exactly 100% together to distribute profit (now {total}%).
errors_finance.MONTH_NOT_CLOSED: Only a month that has ended can be distributed.
errors_finance.ALREADY_DISTRIBUTED: This month has already been distributed.
errors_finance.PARTNER_HAS_HISTORY: This partner has transactions on record. Mark them inactive instead.
errors_finance.SHARE_IN_DISTRIBUTION: Profit shares are removed by cancelling the month's distribution.
errors_finance.BUDGET_EXISTS: There is already a budget for this category.
